card.fires_on: Short middle pieces of rare names split into several parts, such as drug names (dextromethorphan, zolmitriptan, dexmedetomidine) and foreign or personal names (Mimi DiMatteo, Steve McCurry, My Son).

modes.description: A middle piece of a person or place name, often non-English.
